description: 河川復育常見問答 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 「資料來源為本署河川復育網與ｅ河川網站，110年7月已關站，本資料不再更新」。 本資料集包含蒐集相關河川生態廊道、河川生態工程、生態旅遊、防洪、環境改善、水利生態、河川棲地等水資源教室、河川復育、保育、河川日、水利常識、親水常問相關問答。 本資料集係由水利署資訊室臺灣河川復育網資料庫管理系統所提供。 主要以「預知民眾需求」、「環境教育」... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
